reason: I've been on a statin for years and I already know which dishes to avoid, so I don't see what an app adds. I'm also not going to hold my phone up to a menu in a restaurant full of people.
objection: Pointing my phone at the menu in front of my wife and the waiter, and paying a yearly subscription I'll forget to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: A way to check the menu at home before I go out, with no photo in public and no subscription to remember to cancel.
